import os, subprocess, json
from pathlib import Path

wt=Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/rollout-20261007")
expected="1d92d174d49e058e0dfe46d55b5fe7bceba70fe5"

def run(args, cwd=wt, check=True, env=None):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=cwd,text=True,capture_output=True,check=check,env=env)

head=run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip()
branch=run(["git","branch","--show-current"]).stdout.strip()
status=run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout.strip()
if head!=expected or branch!="feat/staged-runtime-rollout-20261007" or status:
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected state head={head} branch={branch} status={status!r}")

env=os.environ.copy()
env["PYTHONPATH"]=str(wt/"src")

full=run(["python3","-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests","-v"],check=False,env=env)
print("=== full stdout ==="); print(full.stdout)
print("=== full stderr ==="); print(full.stderr)
print("full_rc="+str(full.returncode))
if full.returncode:
    raise SystemExit(full.returncode)

print("=== dry-run real project upgrade preflights ===")
for project in ["/Users/steventran/do-again","/Users/steventran/jobpipe","/Users/steventran/Sonary"]:
    p=run(["python3","-m","do_again.cli","upgrade",project],check=False,env=env)
    print("PROJECT",project,"RC",p.returncode)
    print(p.stdout)
    print(p.stderr)
    if p.returncode!=0:
        raise SystemExit(f"dry-run upgrade failed for {project}")

print("head_after="+run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip())
print("status_after="+repr(run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout))
